correctness.rationale: Matsushita--Wakatsuki Theorem 1.1 gives homology concentrated in degree n-1 for all n>=2. An exact 8-state signed transfer and reduced equivariant Hopf-trace calculation produce the four character entries. The all-state integer identities (T^6-I)1=v, Tv=-v, alpha=T^2 1, beta=1-T1+T^3 1 imply the period-six recurrences and the 12-step character increment for all n, with no finite-inference step. Four rational Fourier coefficients give nonnegative integral constituent increments (1,2,1,0) or (1,0,1,2). Replayed exact finite checks substantiate orientation signs and arithmetic. Integral/canonical decompositions are not claimed.
